requirement.requirement_text: The system runs on demand: it starts manually, or optionally when a new client row is added to a Google Sheets queue. Inputs: client configuration and sector guidance; source evidence documents stored in Google Drive; and Google Sheets data containing RACI, tools inventory, KPI snapshot, and benchmarks. The system shall: (1) load the client configuration and sector guidance, download the source evidence from Google Drive, and read the RACI, tools inventory, KPI snapshot, and benchmarks from Google Sheets; (2) normalize and score the collected evidence into a single structured current-state dataset with basic data-quality signals; (3) use a language model to analyze inefficiencies and generate AI/automation recommendations aligned to the selected sector and compliance needs; (4) use a language model to generate a future-state target operating model (org design, technology architecture, roadmap, and a new RACI) and calculate cautious/hybrid/aggressive ROI scenarios; (5) build Mermaid diagrams and generate an executive transformation report plus an internal consultant rationale, then assemble a final payload. Visible outcomes: the structured outputs (models, recommendations, RACI, diagrams, audit summary, executive summary, KPI benchmarking/projections) are written to Google Sheets, and a consolidated text report is uploaded to Google Drive. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text: The system runs daily on a schedule. Input: a Google Sheet configuration listing monitoring targets of two types — topic keywords (search terms) and competitor subreddits. For each target, the system shall: (1) route the task into one of two paths (Competitor vs. Keyword) based on the input type; (2) use a cloud browser automation service to navigate to the target Reddit pages and extract the latest posts without getting blocked; (3) clean the scraped data and combine the top 3 posts for the target; (4) use an AI agent to analyze the data and generate an executive summary for each topic, summarizing the top 3 trending posts into a single concise daily report and filtering out noise; (5) automatically clean, format, and archive the intelligence with source links into Google Sheets, appending the final reports to the Report sheet. Visible outcome: a daily intelligence digest, archived in the Report Google Sheet with columns Date, Competitor/Keyword, Summary, and Link. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text: The system triggers when a new Gmail email arrives from the configured specific sender and downloads the attached document (a bill of lading). The system shall: (1) use a language model to analyze the attachment and rewrite the bill of lading content into a structured Markdown format; (2) use a second language model agent with a structured output schema to convert the Markdown into validated JSON fields for shipper, consignee, shipment details, and line items; (3) run a programmatic validation that compares customer order package/weight values against the carrier line items and append a validation result to the JSON; (4) send the resulting JSON payload to an external HTTP webhook endpoint; (5) use a language model to draft an HTML acceptance reply email based on the validated data and send it back to the original sender via Gmail. Visible outcomes: the structured JSON payload is delivered to the external webhook endpoint, and the original sender receives an HTML acceptance reply email. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text: Users interact with the system via LINE messages received through a webhook. The system validates the message type (image or command) and behaves as follows: (1) when a user sends a handwritten memo image, the system saves the image to Google Drive, runs AI OCR on it and generates structured data, safely parses and validates the AI output, stores the memo record in Google Sheets, and sends a completion message to the user — the memo is analyzed, summarized, tagged, and saved automatically, with a title and summary automatically generated and tags extracted for knowledge organization; (2) when a user sends a tag command (#タグ名), the system searches memos that contain the specified tag; (3) when a user sends the tag-list command (#タグリスト), the system displays all tags currently stored in the database. Each stored memo record includes: Title, Summary, Tags, Timestamp, and a Link to the original image (images are archived in Google Drive, allowing easy access to the original memo later). If OCR fails, the user receives guidance to retake the photo.

requirement.requirement_text: The system runs on a 6-hour schedule (a manual trigger is also available for testing and one-off runs). It pulls fresh content from The Verge, TechCrunch, and Ars Technica RSS feeds, with smart filtering ensuring only new, unposted articles are processed. For each new article the system shall: (1) transform the RSS content into an engaging Medium-style article using AI models; (2) automatically generate a relevant image prompt for cover visuals and generate professional marketing-style cover images; (3) create a Google Doc with the formatted article for easy review; (4) send a preview to a Slack channel/DM for human approval and wait for explicit approval before publishing. Upon approval, the system shall auto-publish the article to Medium, send the formatted content via Gmail, store everything in Google Drive for archiving, and update Google Sheets to prevent duplicates. If the content is rejected, the system sends a clean rejection notification via Slack and does not publish the content.

requirement.requirement_text: A student or faculty member fills out a form with subject code, syllabus topics, and their email address. requirement.requirement_text: The system runs every hour and searches Gmail for messages that have attachments and match the query 'invoice OR bill OR receipt'. It skips emails with no attachments and splits each email into individual items so each attachment is processed separately. For each PDF attachment the system shall: (1) extract the text from the PDF; (2) send the extracted text to an AI agent that returns invoice data as JSON; (3) parse and normalize the JSON into a consistent schema (for example invoice number, dates, vendor details, totals, and tax) and convert numeric values; (4) append the normalized invoice record to a Google Sheets tracker, using invoice_number as the matching column. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text: The system receives B2B targeting research requests via a POST webhook (or manual test runs) and normalizes the targeting criteria; the required criteria fields are target_market, target_industries, and target_roles. It validates the required fields and returns a 400 webhook response when the criteria are incomplete. For valid requests the system shall: (1) call a configurable company-discovery HTTP API, remove excluded companies, and use a language model to evaluate fit and generate evidence that is converted into a weighted account score; (2) filter out low-scoring accounts, check Airtable to avoid duplicates, and create a 'Qualified' account record for new matches; (3) call a configurable contact-discovery HTTP API for each qualified account, then use a language model to score each contact's relevance and filter out low-scoring or duplicate contacts using Airtable; (4) use a language model to generate an evidence-based outreach brief and create an Airtable queue item with status 'Needs Human Review'; (5) return a compact JSON result for webhook requests. Additionally, the system runs daily on a schedule to load 'Needs Human Review' items from Airtable, identify stale reviews, and optionally email a summary via Gmail.

requirement.requirement_text: The system is called as a sub-workflow, triggered by a parent workflow that provides pre-analysed video data (transcript, key moments/sections, visual analysis, and metadata). For each source video it shall: (1) extract and structure the key snippets, B-roll timestamps, and video context ready for AI processing; (2) use a language model-powered AI agent to analyse the transcript, key moments, and video overview and generate 3 unique short-form concepts per video, each including a hook, body structure, CTA, full avatar script, and a lead magnet deliverable prompt, using structured output parsing to guarantee clean JSON; (3) loop through each concept and run the full production pipeline in parallel for each one: (a) send each concept's full script to an avatar video generation service to generate a vertical (1080×1920) AI avatar video, poll the status endpoint until rendering is complete, and capture the avatar video URL; (b) while the avatar renders, determine what B-roll is needed via an AI Video Director and send prompts to a video generation service to generate 2-second vertical clips at 24fps and 720p, with multiple clips generated and aggregated; (c) use a language model-powered AI Video Director to create a beat-by-beat storyboard with dynamic layout transitions, specifying layout types (avatar full-frame for hooks/CTAs, split-screen for demos, picture-in-picture overlays for focus moments), transition effects, and timing; (d) convert the storyboard into a render payload assembling avatar video, B-roll clips, transitions, text overlays, and effects into a single 1080×1920 composition, send the render to a rendering service, poll until complete, and download it; (e) upload the finished video to Google Drive and share it; (f) use a language model-powered Social Media Copywriter to generate platform-optimised titles, descriptions, hashtags, and captions for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok, and log everything to a Google Sheets tracker; (g) in parallel, use a language model-powered Document Generator to create a downloadable lead magnet (actionable guide, template, checklist, etc.) based on the CTA promise from each concept, convert it to HTML, upload it as a Google Doc, share it publicly, and link it in the tracker sheet. Visible outcomes: for each source video, 3 unique shorts are generated, and for each short — a finished rendered vertical video (1080×1920 MP4) uploaded to Google Drive; AI avatar narration with hook, body, and CTA; AI-generated B-roll video clips; dynamic layouts with scroll-stopping transitions; platform-optimised copy (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok); a lead magnet Google Doc with shareable link; and a full tracking row in Google Sheets. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text: The system runs on schedules and via a webhook. (A) Event reminders: it runs daily on a schedule, retrieves event records from Supabase, and filters to upcoming, non-low-priority events; it calculates the days remaining for each event and keeps only events occurring within the next 0–7 days; for each due event it uses a language model to generate a concise reminder email subject and body, sends the reminder email through Gmail, and logs the sent notification to a Supabase notifications table. (B) Important days: on a second daily schedule it retrieves 'important days' from Supabase, calculates the next occurrence date, and checks whether the day matches the configured 'notify days before' value; it prevents duplicate 'important day' notifications by checking Supabase, generates a reminder email with a language model, and sends it via Gmail. (C) Content ideas: it receives a POST webhook request with platform/topic/audience inputs, generates structured content JSON using a language model, stores it in Supabase, and returns the JSON in the webhook response. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统对外提供一个统一的 Webhook 接口，用于处理学习辅导类请求。请求以 POST 方式提交，请求体中携带要调用的模块名称以及该模块所需的输入字段。系统按请求体中的模块名称分发到以下五类处理：
1. 学习笔记（notes）：接收主题、难度、语言和格式四项输入，调用语言模型生成结构化的学习笔记，并以 JSON 形式返回笔记内容。
2. 视频检索（youtube_search）：按给定的检索词和语言查询 YouTube Data API，返回最多 10 个匹配的视频，将结果整理为规整的视频列表后以 JSON 形式返回。
3. 测验（quiz）：按请求中指定的题目数量，调用语言模型生成对应数量的单选题，将模型输出解析为合法 JSON 后返回题目、选项、答案和解析。
4. 职业路线图（roadmap）：接收职业类别和岗位，调用语言模型生成包含里程碑、学习资源和进度安排的结构化路线图对象，并以 JSON 形式返回。
5. 学习教练（assistant）：创建或复用一个会话 ID，结合会话记忆存储中的历史上下文与语言模型生成针对当前对话的辅导回复，并以 JSON 形式返回助手消息。

source_spans.text: Receives a POST webhook request and reads the requested module from body.module.
For notes, sends the topic, difficulty, language, and format to Mistral Cloud to generate structured study notes and returns { notes: ... } as JSON.
For youtube_search, queries the YouTube Data API for up to 10 videos matching the provided search term and language, formats the results into a clean videos array, and returns it as JSON.

For quiz, prompts Mistral Cloud to generate exactly the requested number of multiple-choice questions, parses the model output into valid JSON, and returns the quiz questions with options, answers, and explanations.
For roadmap, sends the provided career category and role to Mistral Cloud to generate a structured roadmap object (milestones, resources, and progress) and returns it as JSON.
For assistant, creates or reuses a session ID, uses Postgres chat memory plus Mistral Cloud to generate a contextual coaching reply, and returns the assistant message as JSON.

系统每周定时运行一次，用于识别竞品 YouTube 频道中表现异常突出的视频。
输入与配置：加载待扫描的竞品频道地址与扫描配置。
处理过程：
1. 通过数据采集服务对竞品 YouTube 频道发起发现式抓取，并轮询抓取快照的状态直至结果就绪；
2. 下载抓取到的视频数据，计算每个视频的日均播放量；将每个视频与其所属频道自身的中位数基线比较，超过基线的标记为异常突出视频；短视频（shorts）单独处理；
3. 读取 Google Sheets 中的历史结果，剔除在配置的冷却窗口内已经输出过简报的视频，然后按配置的每轮上限选取排名靠前的异常突出视频；
4. 使用语言模型从每个异常突出视频的转录开头和章节标题中提取钩子类型、核心承诺和主题，并生成一份跨视频的简短内容简报。
输出：每个异常突出视频在 Google Sheets 中追加一行记录；同时向配置的 Slack 频道发送一份格式化、按排名排列的摘要，摘要中包含上述内容简报。

source_spans.text: Runs on a weekly schedule and loads the competitor channel URLs and scan settings.
Triggers a Bright Data YouTube discovery dataset scrape and polls the snapshot status until the results are ready.
Downloads the scraped video data and calculates views-per-day, then flags outliers by comparing each video to its own channel’s median baseline (with shorts handled separately).
Reads prior results from Google Sheets and filters out videos briefed within the configured cooldown window, selecting the top outliers up to the per-run limit.
Uses OpenAI (GPT-5.6) to extract hook type, promise, and topics from each outlier’s transcript opening and chapter titles, then generates a short cross-video content brief.
Appends one row per outlier to Google Sheets and posts a formatted ranked digest (including the brief) to the configured Slack channel.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统提供一个 Telegram 机器人，用户通过文本、语音或图片与机器人交互，由 AI 智能体生成或修改图片。
输入与鉴权：用户通过 Telegram 发送消息、语音留言或图片；系统依据用户的 Telegram ID 进行鉴权，仅通过鉴权的用户可使用该服务。
输入处理：
- 文本消息：直接交给 AI 智能体处理；
- 语音消息：先经语音转写能力转换为文本；
- 图片：从 Telegram 下载后上传至文件托管服务，并生成可公开访问的 URL。
处理过程：
1. AI 智能体分析用户输入，判断执行文生图（根据文字描述生成新图片）还是图生图（依据提示词修改已有图片）；
2. 智能体调用相应的图像生成能力执行生成任务；
3. 生成采用异步方式：提交任务后按任务标识轮询生成结果，直至结果返回。
输出：图片生成完成后，通过 Telegram 消息将图片发回给用户。

source_spans.text: This workflow creates a Telegram bot that uses AI to generate and transform images through Grok Imagine models, with support for text, voice, and image inputs.
Telegram Input Handling: Users interact with the bot by sending messages, voice notes, or images. The workflow authenticates users based on their Telegram ID.

Text messages → Directly sent to the AI agent
   Voice messages → Transcribed using OpenAI Whisper, then converted to text
   Images → Downloaded from Telegram, uploaded to an FTP server (BunnyCDN), and the public URL is generated

analyzes user input and determines whether to:
   Generate a new image from text description (text-to-image)
   Transform an existing image using a prompt (image-to-image)

Text-to-Image: Creates images from text prompts using "grok-imagine/text-to-image" model
   Image-to-Image: Modifies existing images using "grok-imagine/image-to-image" model
The workflow uses Wait nodes to handle asynchronous image generation, polling Kie.ai for results via task IDs.
Once images are generated, they're sent back to the user through Telegram messages.

系统用于自动生成针对特定疾病与患者人群的个性化自然健康指南。
输入：用户通过网页表单提交患者信息，包括疾病、年龄和性别。
处理过程：
1. 内容生成：使用语言模型依据提交的疾病信息生成完整的健康指南，内容包括医学信息、自然疗法、预防策略和疗愈食谱，并按疾病、年龄、性别对内容进行个性化定制；
2. 自动质量评估：由语言模型担任评估器，对生成内容的完整性与准确性进行审查；
3. 迭代优化：未达到质量标准时，由语言模型自动优化内容并重新评估，最多迭代 5 次；
4. 审核通过后，对内容进行专业排版（统一样式与分节标记），并附加本地时间与 UTC 双时区时间戳；
5. 导出为 Google Docs 文档；同时记录执行指标，包括使用的 token 数、处理耗时和质量迭代次数，用于性能追踪。
输出：生成的健康指南以 Google Docs 文档形式交付，用户可从 Google Docs 下载该指南。

requirement.requirement_text:
系统每周定时运行一次，用于从 TikTok 检索结果中找出互动表现突出的话题标签与配乐。
输入与配置：从统一配置中加载待分析的话题列表及阈值参数，包括每个话题的取样帖数、最低播放量、提升幅度（lift）和冷却期（cooldown）。
处理过程：
1. 对每个话题通过数据采集服务发起 TikTok 发现式抓取，并轮询抓取进度直至快照就绪（超时则不再等待）；
2. 下载抓取到的帖子，计算每篇帖子的互动率；再分别按话题标签和按配乐聚合，仅保留互动率超过该话题中位数且达到配置提升幅度、并且帖子数量足够的分组；
3. 读取 Google Sheets 中已记录的标签，剔除在冷却窗口内已经报送过的标签或配乐；
4. 使用语言模型从每个标签下表现最好帖子的文案中提取内容形式、切入角度和主题，对最终列表排序，并生成一份简短的策略简报。
输出：每个入选的标签或配乐在 Google Sheets 中追加一行记录；同时向配置的 Slack 频道发送一份格式化的排名摘要，摘要中包含指标数据和表现最好帖子的链接。

source_spans.text: Runs weekly on a schedule and loads the topic list and thresholds (posts per topic, minimum plays, lift, and cooldown) from a central configuration.
Triggers a Bright Data TikTok discovery scrape for each topic, then polls the Bright Data progress endpoint until the snapshot is ready (or times out).

Downloads the scraped posts and computes per-post engagement rate, then aggregates results by hashtag and by sound and keeps only groups that beat the topic’s median engagement by the configured lift and have enough posts.
Reads previously logged tags from Google Sheets and filters out any tag/sound that was reported within the cooldown window.
Uses OpenAI GPT-5.6 to extract a content format, angle, and topics from the captions of each tag’s best-performing posts, then ranks the final list and generates a short strategy brief.

requirement.requirement_text:
当用户在 GitLab 合并请求（merge request）讨论区发布触发评论时，启动代码审查流程。
输入：用户在 GitLab 合并请求讨论区发布的触发评论；系统据此加载该合并请求的变更内容。
处理过程：
1. 将变更差异按每个变更文件拆分为一个条目，跳过不适合行内评审的文件；
2. 由语言模型担任三个并行审查者，分别针对缺陷、安全和可维护性审查每个文件；
3. 汇总三个审查者的结论，再由语言模型进行复核：剔除力度不足或重复的结论，并统一严重程度与置信度的表示；
4. 仅发布置信度达到配置阈值的审查结论。
输出与分支：
- 若能解析到有效的 GitLab 差异位置，则在对应位置创建行内评审评论；
- 否则退化为在触发评论所在的讨论区中回复评论；
- 同时发布一条总结性回复，标记本次审查已完成。

source_spans.text: This template is for teams that use GitLab merge requests and want a practical AI-assisted review workflow in n8n. It is useful for engineering teams that want faster first-pass reviews, consistent review comments, and a simple way to separate likely bugs, security risks, and maintainability issues before a human reviewer takes over.

This workflow starts when a user posts a trigger comment in a GitLab merge request discussion. It loads the merge request changes, splits the diff into one item per changed file, and skips files that are not suitable for inline review.

Each file is then reviewed in parallel by three AI reviewers focused on bugs, security, and maintainability. Their findings are merged and sent to a verifier step, which removes weak or duplicate findings and normalizes severity and confidence.

Only findings that pass the configured confidence threshold are posted. If a valid GitLab diff position can be resolved, the workflow creates an inline review comment. Otherwise, it falls back to a reply comment in the trigger discussion. A summary reply is also posted to mark the review as completed.

GitLab project with merge request discussions enabled
n8n credentials for GitLab API access
AI chat model credentials for the reviewer and verifier nodes

处理过程：
1. 将产品图片与提示词提交给语言模型进行产品细节提取，然后使用语言模型生成结构化的 UGC 图片提示词、视频提示词以及反向约束；
2. 将模型返回内容解析为规整的字段，调用图像生成能力生成图片，随后将提示词预览发布到 Discord；
3. 通过第二个表单收集审核人的决定：
   - 通过：启动视频生成；

   - 拒绝：终止流程；

Collects a reviewer decision in a second n8n Form and either starts Replicate video generation, regenerates the prompts using the reviewer feedback, or stops on rejection.
If approved, submits the video prompt to Replicate (minimax/video-01), waits, polls the prediction status until it succeeds, and posts the resulting video URL to Discord.
Sets final job metadata, saves a job record to an n8n Data Table, and sends a completion notification to Discord.

处理过程：
1. 内容获取：自动抓取该链接对应的视频详情与字幕文本；若为播放列表，可一次处理其中的多个视频（可能会询问需要处理的数量）；
2. 内容理解：由语言模型阅读字幕文本、理解内容并生成摘要；
3. 存储与上下文：将处理后的信息与摘要存入向量数据库，以便进行对话检索；同时使用上下文存储记住当前正在讨论的视频或播放列表。
交互与输出：用户可就播放列表或视频内容向 AI 助手提问。由于上下文被保持，用户可以就同一视频或播放列表连续追问，而无需再次提供链接。支持的具体问法包括：
- 获取单个视频或整个播放列表的快速摘要；
- 询问要点或讨论过的主要话题；
- 查询视频中提到的特定信息；
- 要求对之前提到的某一点展开说明；
- 在不必完整观看的情况下理解复杂主题。

source_spans.text: This n8n workflow transforms entire YouTube playlists or single videos into interactive knowledge bases you can chat with.
Provide a Link: Start by giving the workflow a URL for a YouTube playlist or a single video.
Content Retrieval: The workflow automatically fetches the video details and transcripts for the provided link. For playlists, it can process multiple videos at once (you might be asked how many).
AI Processing: Google's Gemini AI reads through the transcripts, understands the content, and creates summaries.

Storage & Context: The processed information and summaries are stored in a vector database (Qdrant), making them ready for conversation. Context is managed using Redis, remembering the current video/playlist you're discussing.

Chat & Ask: Now, you can ask the AI agent questions about the playlist or video content! Because context is maintained, you can ask follow-up questions (like "expand on point X") without needing to provide the URL again.
Engage with the AI agent to explore the video content. Since the agent remembers the context of your conversation, you can ask detailed follow-up questions naturally:

Get a quick summary of a single video or an entire playlist.
Ask for key takeaways or main topics discussed.
Query for specific information mentioned in the videos.
Ask the agent to elaborate on a specific point previously mentioned.
Understand complex subjects without watching the full duration.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统每天定时从多个 AI 资讯 RSS 源选题，自动生成并发布 LinkedIn 组织主页帖子。
触发与输入：系统每天按计划触发一次，并按发布日节奏执行；设有安全闸门，在手动或测试执行时阻止实际发布。系统从 Airtable 加载最近的发布历史，并从 TechCrunch AI、The Verge AI 等多个 AI 资讯 RSS 源拉取最新文章。
处理过程：
1. 对 RSS 文章进行清洗、去重与均衡处理，然后将候选文章连同最近发布历史提交给语言模型，从中选出一条可发布的编辑选题；
2. 若选中的选题达到质量阈值：由语言模型撰写 LinkedIn 帖子初稿，再由语言模型进行第二遍精简，随后自动追加 2–3 个相关话题标签；
3. 在 Airtable 中创建一条编辑记录，保存最终文案、来源链接与元数据；
4. 生成一张方形的编辑配图，可选使用 HTML 截图服务或图像生成能力；随后由语言模型对配图做质量检查，若不通过则重新生成。
输出：在生产模式下，将配图注册并上传到 LinkedIn，并把帖子发布到 LinkedIn 组织主页；最后将发布结果写回 Airtable。

source_spans.text: Runs each day on a scheduled trigger and applies a posting-day cadence plus a safety gate that blocks publishing during manual/test executions.
Loads recent publishing history from Airtable and pulls fresh articles from TechCrunch AI, The Verge AI, and the OpenAI Blog RSS feeds.
Cleans, deduplicates, and balances the RSS articles, then sends the candidates plus recent history to OpenAI to select one publishable editorial signal.
If the selected signal meets the quality threshold, OpenAI drafts the LinkedIn post, a second OpenAI pass tightens it, and the workflow appends 2–3 relevant hashtags.
Creates an editorial record in Airtable with the final copy, source URL, and metadata.
Generates a square editorial image using either an optional HTML screenshot service or OpenAI image generation, then uses OpenAI to QA the image and retries generation if it fails.
In production mode, registers and uploads the image to LinkedIn and publishes the post to a LinkedIn organization page, then writes the posting result back to Airtable.

系统用于对客服收件箱中的邮件进行自动分诊与回复。
输入：通过 EmailConnect webhook 接收到的入站邮件内容，包含发件人与邮件正文，以及邮件携带的垃圾邮件评分。
处理过程：
1. 垃圾邮件过滤：若邮件携带的垃圾邮件评分存在且大于 10，则丢弃该邮件，不再继续处理；
2. 知识库加载：从 Notion 数据库中读取全部问答条目，并与发件人、邮件正文一起整理成待比对列表；
3. 匹配：使用语言模型（按发件人维护记忆）从知识库中选出最匹配的问答条目 ID；当匹配置信度低于 85% 时返回无匹配结果；
4. 校验与路由：将返回的 ID 与 Notion 数据核对，据此将请求路由到自动回答路径或人工升级路径；
5. 匹配成功时：使用语言模型基于匹配到的 Notion 答案起草结构化回复，并通过邮件发送给客户；
6. 无匹配时：使用语言模型起草结构化的受理确认，通过邮件将原始请求发送给内部团队，并通过邮件将受理确认发送给客户。

source_spans.text: Receives an inbound email payload via an EmailConnect webhook.
Drops the message if the provided spam score exists and is greater than 10.
Loads all Q&A entries from a Notion database and formats them into a comparison list alongside the sender and message text.
Uses an OpenRouter chat model (with per-sender memory) to select the closest knowledge base question ID or return NO_MATCH when confidence is below 85%.
Validates the returned ID against the Notion data and routes the request to either the answer path or the escalation path.
If a match is found, uses an OpenRouter chat model (with per-sender memory) to draft a structured reply grounded in the matched Notion answer and sends it to the customer via SMTP.

If no match is found, uses an OpenRouter chat model (with per-sender memory) to draft a structured acknowledgement, emails your team the original request via SMTP, and sends the acknowledgement to the customer via SMTP.

系统提供一个基于 Telegram 的营养助手，用户可通过 AI 助手记录饮食、计算营养素摄入并跟踪营养目标。
输入：用户通过 Telegram 以文本、语音或图片方式发送的消息。
处理过程与行为：
1. 多模态输入：文本消息直接由 AI 助手处理；语音消息经转写后处理；食物图片由 AI 进行识别分析；
2. 餐食记录：识别或理解用户描述的餐食后，自动估算热量、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪，并写入餐食记录；
3. 用户注册：提供简单的注册引导，不存储个人健康数据（不需要体重或身高）；
4. 目标管理：用户可设置并更新每日热量目标和蛋白质目标；
5. 日报：向用户推送个性化的每日进度消息，并带有可视化的进度条；

典型交互：
- 用户发送一张餐食照片 → AI 识别食物并记录热量与营养素；
- 用户发送一段语音 → AI 转写后记录该餐；

source_spans.text: It allows users to interact with an AI agent via text, voice, or images to track meals, calculate macros, and monitor nutrition goals directly from Telegram.
The system integrates Google Sheets as the database, handling both user profiles and meal logs, while leveraging Gemini AI for natural conversation, food recognition, and daily progress reports.
Multi-input support: Text, voice messages (transcribed), and food images (AI analysis).

User-friendly registration: Simple onboarding without storing personal health data (no weight/height required).
Goal tracking: Users can set and update calorie and protein targets.
Daily reports: Personalized progress messages with visual progress bars.
User sends a photo of a meal → AI analyzes the food and logs calories/macros.
User sends a voice message → AI transcribes and logs the meal.
User types “report” → AI returns a daily nutrition summary with progress bars.
User says “update my protein goal” → AI updates profile in Google Sheets.

系统根据用户提交的创意或现成文稿自动生成完整视频。
输入：用户通过表单提交以下内容：
- 主题或现成文稿；
- 期望的视频时长；
- 选定的语音合成音色；
- 视觉风格（例如 Pixar、Lego、Cyberpunk）；
- 图像生成服务的选择。
处理过程：
1. 脚本生成：使用语言模型生成吸引人的标题、描述、开场钩子、完整脚本和行动号召；
2. 语音合成：按选定的音色将脚本转换为音频，同时生成带时间戳的字幕；
3. 场景切分：将脚本切分为 5–6 秒的场景片段，用于可视化的分镜规划；
4. 图像提示词生成：按选定的视觉风格，将每个场景转换为图像生成提示词；
5. 图像生成：将提示词提交给图像生成服务，生成各场景图片；
6. 片段制作：依据脚本时间，将每张图片制作成带有 Ken Burns 式缩放效果的短视频片段；
7. 视频合成：将所有片段拼接为一个完整视频，并按此前生成的时间戳叠加字幕。
输出：最终视频上传到 Google Drive 与 Telegram，相关链接保存到 Google Sheets。

requirement.requirement_text:
该需求面向 Telegram 机器人上的多模态助理：能够理解并处理文本、语音消息、图片和文档，可搜索网页、抓取网站、生成图像、执行计算并引用已上传的文档，以文本或音频形式给出结合上下文的回复。

流程在 Telegram 机器人收到一条消息时启动，并按消息类型分别处理：文本消息经格式化后直接交给主智能助理；语音消息先从 Telegram 下载音频文件，再转写为文本；图片消息下载后由视觉理解能力分析其内容；文档消息下载后，其内容被存入临时向量库，使其可被检索。

处理后的输入交给核心智能助理，该助理结合语言模型、会话记忆以及一组工具（网页搜索、网页抓取、图像生成、计算、文档向量库）来形成回复。最后判断初始消息是否为语音留言：若是，则生成语音回复；否则以文本消息的形式把答案发回给用户。

source_spans.text: This workflow transforms your Telegram bot into J.A.R.V.I.S., a powerful, multimodal AI assistant. It can understand and process text, voice messages, images, and documents.

The assistant can search the web, scrape websites, generate images, perform calculations, and reference uploaded documents to provide comprehensive and context-aware responses in either text or audio format.
The workflow begins when a message is received by your Telegram bot.

Text:** The message is formatted and sent directly to the main AI agent.
Voice:** The audio file is downloaded from Telegram and transcribed into text using the OpenAI API.
Image:** The image is downloaded and analyzed by an OpenAI vision model to understand its content.
Document:** The file is downloaded and its content is stored in a temporary vector store, making it searchable for the AI.
This agent uses an OpenAI model, conversational memory, and a suite of tools (Google Search, Web Scraper, Image Generator, Calculator, and the document vector store) to formulate a response.
Finally, the workflow checks if the initial message was a voice note; if so, it generates an audio response. Otherwise, it sends the answer as a text message back to the user.

Automatically:
	fetches fresh news,
	filters out aggregators/PR wires and duplicates,
	writes a human-sounding LinkedIn post with GPT,
	downloads the article image to verify it’s usable,
	publishes to LinkedIn (with or without media),
	and logs the posted titles in Firestore to avoid re-posting.

Runs on a daily schedule (cron) and supports two post variants:
	•	Case 1: article has a description → richer post
	•	Case 2: no description → short, still human and casual
Schedule Trigger (0 10,12,19,21 * * *): runs at 10:00, 12:00, 19:00, 21:00 (server timezone).
Firestore (Get Previous News Titles): loads previously posted titles (document asma/x20) to de-dupe.
HTTP Request (API NEWS): calls newsapi.org with query “AI Startup” for example, last 24–48h window, searchIn=title, sorted by publishedAt.
excludes Biztoc and common aggregators/PR wires (Techmeme, TheFly, PRNewswire, GlobeNewswire, MarketWatch press-releases, Medium, Substack, Yahoo consent, etc.)
requires valid URL + image
groups by topic (normalized title + domain) and picks the best representative
sorts by recency and returns up to 10 unique articles.
IF (URL & De-dupe checks): ensures link present and not already posted (compares against Firestore titles).
IF (Description Checker): branches on presence of description.
LLM Agents (2 prompts): generate a casual, human LinkedIn post in English (no emojis/links/markdown, 2–3 hashtags).
Post setup: cleans the text, passes the image URL forward.
retrieves the image as a file to confirm the link works.

If image OK → posts with media.
	•	Otherwise → posts text-only.
after a successful publish, writes the article’s title to Firestore
Filtering: items missing URL or image are skipped by design. Yahoo consent pages are also skipped.
Image errors: some sites block hotlinking; the image download step will fall back to text-only posting.

该需求用于管理 Yandex Zen 内容生产流程：按周从维基百科分类生成文章选题，按日撰写一篇俄文文章并生成最多两幅配图，成果保存到 Google Docs 与 Google Drive，并在 Google Sheets 中跟踪状态。

触发方式有两种：手动触发生成当日内容，或按每周一 09:00 的计划触发以刷新选题队列。

初始化：在 Google Drive 中查找指定的 Google Sheets 文件；若不存在，则创建该电子表格、所需的工作表（选题、已发布、图片、状态）以及 Google Drive 中的内容文件夹。

选题生成：从 Google Sheets 读取已发布和已排队的标题；向维基百科 API 查询一个随机的女性主题分类；由语言模型生成新的俄文选题；过滤掉重复选题后追加到选题工作表。

内容生成：读取选题工作表，选取一条状态为“新”的选题；由语言模型起草一篇俄文文章，并进行第二轮改写以降低文本中的机械痕迹。随后在 Google Drive 中为该文章创建专属文件夹、创建 Google 文档、写入最终文章文本，并将文档链接公开共享。

配图生成：由语言模型从文章中抽取最多两个配图场景并生成英文配图描述；再由图像生成能力生成图片；把图片上传到 Google Drive 并通过链接共享。

记录：把图片元数据记录到图片工作表；把文章条目追加到已发布工作表；并把该选题行的状态更新为“就绪”，同时附上 Google 文档链接。

source_spans.text: This workflow manages a Yandex Zen content pipeline by generating weekly article topics from Wikipedia categories, then drafting a daily Russian article and up to two illustrations via OpenRouter, saving everything to Google Docs/Drive and tracking status in a Google Sheets database.
Runs either manually for daily generation or on a weekly Monday 09:00 schedule to refresh the topic queue.

Searches Google Drive for a Google Sheets file named Zen_Content_DB and, if missing, creates the spreadsheet, required sheets (Topics/Published/Images/State), and a Zen_Content_Articles folder in Google Drive.

For topic generation, pulls already published and queued titles from Google Sheets, queries the Wikipedia API for a random women-focused category, and uses OpenRouter (Claude Sonnet) to generate new Russian topic ideas while filtering out duplicates before appending them to the Topics sheet.

For content generation, reads the Topics sheet, selects one topic with status = new, and uses OpenRouter (Claude Haiku) to draft a Russian article and then rewrite it in a second pass to reduce AI-sounding patterns.
Creates a per-article folder in Google Drive, creates a Google Doc, inserts the final article text, and shares the document link publicly.

Uses OpenRouter (GPT-5) to extract up to two illustrated scenes and generate English image prompts, then calls OpenRouter Images (Gemini image model) to generate images, uploads them to Google Drive, and shares them via link.
Logs image metadata to the Images sheet, appends the article entry to the Published sheet, and updates the topic row in Topics to status ready with the Google Doc URL.

requirement.requirement_text:

对提交的全部商品，触发评论数据抓取任务，并每 30 秒轮询一次任务状态，直到结果就绪（最长等待 10 分钟）。随后下载评论数据，清洗重复字段，并按商品保留一组经过加权的评论集合，重点纳入差评与最有帮助的评论。

把每个商品的评论集合交给语言模型，抽取结构化的抱怨主题、好评主题与功能诉求。再将自家商品的抱怨主题与竞品的好评主题进行比对，识别两者重叠的部分作为“竞争缺口”，并由语言模型撰写一份简短的竞争简报。

最后，把排名靠前的抱怨与竞争缺口逐条追加到 Google Sheets，并向指定的 Slack 频道发送一份格式化的摘要，摘要中包含上述竞争简报。

source_spans.text: This workflow collects Amazon product URLs via an n8n form, pulls reviews from Bright Data, extracts complaint and praise themes with OpenAI (GPT-5.6), identifies competitive gaps versus up to three competitors, then logs findings to Google Sheets and posts a digest to Slack.
Receives your product URL and up to three competitor Amazon URLs through an n8n form.
Triggers the Bright Data Amazon reviews dataset for all submitted products and polls the snapshot status every 30 seconds until the results are ready (up to 10 minutes).
Downloads the review data, cleans duplicated fields, and keeps a weighted set focused on critical and most-helpful reviews per product.
Sends each product’s review set to OpenAI (GPT-5.6) to extract structured complaint themes, praise themes, and feature requests.
Compares your complaint themes to competitors’ praise themes to identify overlapping “competitive gaps” and uses OpenAI (GPT-5.6) to write a short competitive brief.
Appends one row per top complaint and gap to Google Sheets and posts a formatted digest (including the brief) to a Slack channel.

source_spans.text: This workflow starts from an n8n form submission, reviews all documents in a Google Drive data room using OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini), logs per-document risk findings to Google Sheets, then compiles an executive summary and emails the report via Gmail, with Slack alerts for errors.
Receives a form submission with the deal name, Google Drive folder ID, and a notification email address.
Creates a unique run ID and lists files in Google Drive for the provided data room context.
Loops through each file, downloads it from Google Drive, and extracts the document text.
Sends the extracted text to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) to classify the document and generate a JSON finding with risk level, flags, and a short summary.
Parses the AI output and appends each document’s finding to a Google Sheets “Due Diligence Findings” tab.
After all documents are processed, fetches all findings for the run from Google Sheets and sends them to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) to draft an executive due diligence summary.
Converts the summary to HTML and sends it to the submitted notification email via Gmail.
Posts error alerts to Slack for workflow failures and for issues returned by the OpenAI analysis and summary steps.

requirement.requirement_text:
接收外部预订来源提交的短租预订请求，并校验必填字段与日期先后顺序。

若预订无效：向 Telegram 发送告警，并通过邮件把被跳过的预订内容发送给房东。

若预订有效：规范化预订数据、生成预订编号、把该预订追加到 Google Sheets 的预订工作表，并在 Telegram 通知房东。

每天按计划时间（或通过手动请求）执行一次扫描：读取 Google Sheets 中的预订记录，识别出需要发送入住（明天）、退房（今天）或评价请求（退房后两天）消息的行程。对每个到期的行程，由一个语言模型驱动的助理从 Google Sheets 的手册工作表中查找房源信息，生成一条纯文本消息。每条生成的消息都记录到 Google Sheets 的客人日志工作表，通过邮件发送给客人，并在 Telegram 发布确认。

对于退房当天的预订：在 Google Sheets 的清洁任务工作表中创建一条清洁任务；若已设置清洁人员邮箱，则通过邮件通知清洁人员并在 Telegram 提醒房东，否则提醒房东未设置清洁人员邮箱。

每周一：读取 Google Sheets 中的预订与清洁任务，计算本周统计，由语言模型撰写一份简明的房东周报，并通过邮件与 Telegram 发送给房东；若本周没有任何活动，则改为发送一条“一切正常”的消息。

source_spans.text: This workflow captures short-term rental bookings via webhook, stores them in Google Sheets, drafts guest emails with a Deepseek AI agent using a Google Sheets playbook, sends messages through Gmail, creates checkout-day cleaning tasks, and notifies the host via Telegram with a weekly AI-written digest.
Receives a booking via a webhook request and validates required fields and date order.
If the booking is invalid, sends an alert to Telegram and emails the host via Gmail with the skipped payload.
If the booking is valid, normalizes the booking data, generates a booking ID, appends it to the Google Sheets “Bookings” tab, and notifies the host in Telegram.

Runs a daily sweep on a cron schedule (or via a manual webhook) to read bookings from Google Sheets and identify stays that need a check-in (tomorrow), check-out (today), or review request (two days after checkout) message.
Uses a Deepseek-powered AI agent that looks up property details from the Google Sheets “Playbook” tab to generate one plain-text message per due booking.
Logs each generated message to the Google Sheets “GuestLog” tab, emails it to the guest via Gmail, and posts a confirmation to Telegram.

For check-out day bookings, creates a cleaning task in the Google Sheets “CleaningTasks” tab and either emails the assigned cleaner via Gmail and alerts the host in Telegram, or alerts the host that no cleaner email is set.

Every Monday, reads bookings and cleaning tasks from Google Sheets, computes weekly stats, uses Deepseek to write a concise host digest, and sends it to the host via Gmail and Telegram (or posts an all-clear message if there is no activity).

requirement.requirement_text:
针对一篇指定的博客文章，自动完成标签的生成、创建与分配，得到利于检索、风格一致且结构规范的标签集合。

数据获取与准备：根据提供的文章标识获取该篇 WordPress 文章的内容；同时获取站点上已有的全部标签；随后把这两路数据合并为一个数据结构。

标签分析：把合并后的数据（文章内容与已有标签列表）交给语言模型，由其扮演检索优化专家的角色，分析文章的标题、正文与摘要，从已有标签列表中选取最多 4 个相关标签；若不足 4 个，则补充建议新的标签名称，使标签总数达到 4 个。标签需语义相关、面向用户的搜索意图，且遵循命名规范（例如多词形式或缩写形式）；不得包含无关标签或重复标签。

标签处理与创建：把分析结果分为两类处理。已选中的已有标签，其标签标识直接进入最终更新；建议的新标签则逐个处理，对每个新标签调用 WordPress 接口完成创建，并收集新建标签的标识。

最终分配：把已有标签标识与新建标签标识合并为一个列表，通过更新操作写回该篇 WordPress 文章，完成打标签。

source_spans.text: This workflow automates the full process of generating, creating, and assigning optimized WordPress tags to a specific blog post.

A maximum of 4 total tags
No irrelevant or duplicate tags
Tags follow naming conventions (e.g., multi-word or acronyms)

Data Retrieval & Preparation: The workflow starts by fetching a specific WordPress article using a provided post_id. Simultaneously, it retrieves all existing tags from the WordPress site via the REST API. These two data streams are then merged into a single data structure.

AI-Powered Tag Analysis: The merged data (article content and existing tag list) is sent to an LLM (Claude Opus 4.5). The AI acts as an "SEO expert," analyzing the article's title, content, and excerpt. It follows a strict set of instructions to select up to 4 relevant tags from the existing list and, if needed, suggests new tag names to reach a total of 4 tags.
Tag Processing & Creation: The workflow splits the AI's output into two paths:
Existing Tags: The list of selected tag IDs is prepared for the final update.
New Tags: The list of new tag names is processed in a loop. For each new tag, the workflow sends a POST request to the WordPress API to create it. The newly created tag IDs are collected.

Final Assignment: The existing tag IDs and the newly created tag IDs are merged into a single list. This final list of tag IDs is then sent back to the original WordPress article via an "Update" operation, effectively tagging the post.

source_spans.text: This workflow runs weekly to discover local businesses on Google Maps via Bright Data, score measurable Google Business Profile gaps against nearby peers, extract complaint themes from low-rated reviews with OpenAI (GPT-5.6), then logs prospects to Google Sheets and posts a ranked digest to Slack.

Downloads the discovered business profiles and scores each one based on measurable profile gaps benchmarked against the “people also search” peer set.
Reads previously logged prospects from Google Sheets and filters out businesses contacted within the last 90 days.
Uses OpenAI (GPT-5.6) to extract complaint themes from reviews rated three stars and below for the remaining prospects.
Builds a ranked report, appends one row per prospect to Google Sheets, and posts a formatted digest to a Slack channel.

source_spans.text: This workflow automates lead nurturing by pulling data from Google Sheets, analyzing leads with AI, and sending personalized outreach emails. It runs on a schedule, processes leads in batches, and routes them based on their status and step. AI generates both first-touch and follow-up emails while updating the CRM automatically.
Schedule Trigger – Runs the workflow at set intervals.
Get row(s) in sheet – Fetches lead data from Google Sheets.
If – Filters leads that need action based on status or date.
Code in JavaScript – Normalizes fields like email, name, and company.
Loop Over Items – Processes leads in controlled batches.

requirement.requirement_text:
每 24 小时运行一次，自动推进此前因时机不当而被暂停的线索的再接触。

每次运行时，从 HubSpot 拉取最近的线索及其关键活动与生命周期属性（用于判断跟进时机），单次最多取 20 条；仅保留此前因时机不当被暂停的线索，避免打扰进行中的机会。

符合条件的线索以逐条或分批的方式处理。对每个线索，由语言模型基于线索上下文生成一封简短、友好的再接触跟进邮件正文，不使用客户关系管理系统的内部标签，不带推销口吻；随后把生成结果整理为可用字段：主题、正文、收件人邮箱与负责人信息。

流程不自动发送邮件，而是在 Gmail 中创建一封草稿供人工审阅，并在 Slack 中通知该线索的负责人：草稿已就绪、该线索值得重新跟进。

若语言模型生成失败，则在 Slack 中发送告警，附上该线索的姓名、邮箱与生成错误信息，以便仍能转为人工跟进。

source_spans.text: This workflow automates daily re-engagement for HubSpot leads that were previously paused due to timing. It runs every 24 hours, fetches recent leads with activity data, and filters only those marked as “bad timing,” ensuring active opportunities are not disturbed.

Qualified leads are processed in batches, and an AI agent generates a short, polite follow-up email designed to reopen the conversation without sounding salesy. Instead of sending automatically, the workflow creates a Gmail draft for human review and notifies the assigned owner in Slack.
If AI generation fails, the workflow sends a Slack alert with the lead details so manual follow-up can still happen.
Pulls up to 20 leads with key activity and lifecycle properties needed for follow-up timing.
Keeps only leads that were previously paused due to timing (targets cold opportunities only).
Processes leads one-by-one / in batches to prevent rate-limit issues and keep execution stable.
Creates a short, friendly follow-up message based on lead context (no CRM labels, no salesy tone).
Normalizes AI output into usable fields (subject/body/toEmail/owner details).
Creates a Gmail draft (human-in-the-loop; no auto-send).
Notifies the assigned owner that a draft is ready and the lead is worth revisiting.
Builds a clean error context (lead name/email + AI error message).
Alerts the owner when AI fails so the lead can be followed up manually.

该需求面向基于自有文档的客户问答：客户消息可来自邮件、在线聊天、WhatsApp、Slack 或 Discord，答复依据自有文档检索得到；无依据的答复、负面情绪以及明确的转人工请求会升级为人工处理并生成工单；每次会话都会被分类、记录，并每周汇总上报。

消息接入：客户消息从上述任一渠道到达后被归一化为统一结构，并按渠道分别走独立分支。

五项前置检查在任何一次模型调用之前执行：自动回复与退信、空内容、重复投递、超长消息，以及以六种语言（英语、罗马尼亚语、德语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语）匹配的明确转人工请求。在线聊天渠道在这些路径上都会立即返回响应，使调用方不会停留在未关闭的连接上等待。置信度阈值与最大消息长度可配置。

答复生成：助理依据自有文档作答，文档通过向量知识库以工具方式检索；会话记忆持久化保存，重启后历史仍然可用（保留期默认为 30 天）。

置信度评估：置信度按答复是否有据可依来评估，而不是按答复长度，即助理是否检索了知识库、知识库是否返回了内容；冗长流畅但没有检索依据的答复得分很低。问候与致谢会短路该判定，而不是被判为失败，因此普通的礼貌用语不会触发工单。

回复与升级：置信度达到或超过阈值且无负面情绪时，答复通过原始渠道返回，邮件沿用客户原始主题（加 Re: 前缀），Slack 在会话线程内回复。其余情况升级为人工处理：升级原因直接取自已发生的判断而不再重新判定；由语言模型为人工客服在工单正文中写一段简短说明；工单系统按情绪推导优先级。该链路中某一步失败时仍继续执行，因此单点故障不会导致整条升级失效。

记录与维护：无论自动答复还是升级处理，每次会话都被分类并记录到 Google Sheets，字段包括用户标识、渠道、消息、分类、情绪、时间戳、答复内容、置信度、是否升级与升级原因。每周任务把真实数据发布到 Slack，随后归档这些数据并清理旧的会话记忆。另有手动分支用于导入自有文档，导入前先清除上次结果，因此重复运行不会产生重复内容。

source_spans.text: Answers customer questions on Email, Live Chat, WhatsApp, Slack and Discord from your own documentation, retrieved through a Supabase vector store. Ungrounded answers, negative sentiment and explicit handover requests escalate to a human with a Zendesk ticket. Every conversation is categorised, logged and reported weekly.
A message arrives on Email, Live Chat, WhatsApp, Slack or Discord and is normalised into one schema, with an explicit branch per channel.

Five guards run before a single model call is paid for: auto-replies and bounces, empty bodies, duplicate deliveries, oversized messages, and an explicit request for a human matched in six languages. Live chat receives an HTTP response on each of those paths, so a caller never waits on an open connection.
The agent answers from your documentation, retrieved from a Supabase vector store wired as a tool, with Postgres-backed chat memory so history survives restarts.

Confidence is scored on grounding rather than on answer length: did the agent search the knowledge base, and did the knowledge base return anything. A long, fluent answer with no retrieval behind it scores low.
Greetings and thank-yous short circuit that test instead of failing it, so ordinary politeness does not open a support ticket.
At or above the threshold, and without negative sentiment, the answer goes back on the originating channel. Email keeps the customer's own subject, Slack replies in thread.

Otherwise the case escalates. The reason is derived from what already happened rather than re-decided, an AI step writes a short note for the human agent into the ticket body, and Zendesk gets a priority derived from sentiment. The chain keeps going if a step fails, so one outage cannot delete an entire escalation.

Every conversation, answered or escalated, is categorised and logged to Google Sheets. A weekly job posts real figures to Slack, then archives them and purges old chat memory. A manual branch ingests your documentation, clearing the previous run first so re-running never duplicates anything.
until it has, grounding scores zero and everything routes to a human, which is the intended fallback
Confidence threshold and maximum message length live in the Workflow Configuration node.
Chat memory retention lives in Weekly Configuration and defaults to 30 days.
Keyword gates cover English, Romanian, German, French, Spanish and Italian across handover detection, escalation reasons, categorisation and small talk.
Email replies carry the customer's own subject, prefixed with Re:, which is how Gmail and Outlook group a conversation.

按计划时间自动监控 Google Sheets 中记录的竞品商品价格：抓取商品页面、由语言模型抽取价格与优惠信息、与历史值比较，据此更新记录并生成市场情报报告，最后通过邮件发送报告并重置数据以进入下一轮执行。

读取与抓取：运行时读取竞品数据与商品链接，逐条处理每个竞品条目：抓取商品页面原始内容，并清洗整理出供模型处理的文本。

价格抽取与记录：由语言模型抽取商品名称、价格与优惠信息，并转换为结构化数据。随后判断该商品是否为首次记录：若是，则保存初始值；否则将当前价格与优惠同历史值比较，检测到变化时更新记录。即使未检测到变化，也会更新记录，因此价格变化与无变化两种情形都会被处理。

分析与汇总：全部条目处理完毕后，取回更新后的数据集，汇总为结构化的市场对比数据，由语言模型生成战略洞察与建议，并把生成的分析摘要保存回 Google Sheets。

报告与重置：把报告排版为 HTML 邮件格式，通过 Gmail 发送最终报告。最后取回本轮处理后的数据，把当前数据转入历史记录并清空相应字段，为下一轮执行做准备。

source_spans.text: This workflow automatically detects the language of every new Gmail email and translates non-English messages into English. The translated email is forwarded to your inbox with a clear "[TRANSLATED]" subject tag, and a label is added for easy filtering.

Gmail New Email Trigger  
   Listens for new unread emails in your Gmail inbox.  
   Captures subject, sender, body text, and metadata.  

Normalize Email Data  
   A Code node extracts the raw content from the email.  
   Strips HTML, normalizes plain text, and prepares data for language detection.  

Detect Language (OpenAI)  
   Uses OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo to detect the email’s language.  
   If the language is English, workflow ends.  
   If not, continues to translation.  

Translate to English  
   OpenAI translates the email body into clear English.  

Prepare Translated Email  
   Builds a forwarded email containing:  
     Original sender & subject  
     Received date  
     Message ID  
     Translated content (with formatting)  

Send Translated Email  
   A Gmail node sends the translated message to your inbox.  
   Subject is prefixed with [TRANSLATED] for easy recognition.  

Add "Translated Emails" Label  
   Automatically tags the original message in Gmail with "Translated Emails".  
   Helps you filter all auto-translated emails later.  

🛠️ Setup Steps

📘 Description
This workflow automates the complete DPDP-aligned Consent Manager Registration screening pipeline — from intake to eligibility evaluation and final compliance routing.
Every incoming registration request is normalized, validated, logged, evaluated by an AI compliance engine (GPT-4o), and then routed into either approval or rejection flows.
It intelligently handles missing documentation (treated as a minor issue), evaluates financial/technical/operational capacity, generates structured eligibility JSON, updates registration records in Google Sheets, and sends outcome-specific emails to applicants and compliance teams.
 The workflow creates a full audit trail while reducing manual screening workload and ensuring consistent eligibility decisions.

⚙️ What This Workflow Does (Step-by-Step)
▶️ Receive Consent Registration Event (Webhook)
 Collects incoming Consent Manager registration applications and triggers the processing pipeline.
🧹 Extract & Normalize Registration Payload (Code Node)
 Cleans the body payload and extracts key fields:
 action, organizationName, applicationType, contactEmail, netWorth, technicalCapacity, operationalCapacity, documentAttached, submittedAt.
🔍 Validate Registration Payload Structure (IF Node)
 Checks the presence of mandatory fields.
 Valid → continue to eligibility evaluation
 Invalid → log in the audit sheet.
📄 Log Invalid Registration Requests to Sheet (Google Sheets)
 Stores malformed or incomplete submissions for audit, follow-up, and retry handling.
📝 Write Initial Registration Entry to Sheet (Google Sheets)
 Creates the initial intake row in the master registration sheet before applying eligibility logic.
🧠 Configure GPT-4o — Eligibility Evaluation Model (Azure OpenAI)
 Prepares the AI model used to determine whether the applicant meets DPDP’s eligibility criteria.
🤖 AI Eligibility Evaluator (DPDP Compliance)
 Analyzes applicant data and evaluates their eligibility based on:
 financial capacity, technical capability, operational readiness, and documentation status.
 Missing documents → NOT a rejection condition.
 Returns strictly formatted JSON with: eligible, riskLevel, decisionReason, missingItems, recommendedNextSteps.
🧼 Parse AI Eligibility JSON Output (Code Node)
 Converts AI output into valid JSON by removing markdown artifacts and ensuring safe parsing.
🔎 Validate Eligibility Status (IF Node)
 Routes the outcome:
 Eligible → approval workflow
 Ineligible → rejection email.
📧 Send Rejection Email to Applicant (Gmail)
 Sends a structured rejection email listing issues and re-submission instructions.
🔗 Merge Registration + Eligibility Summary (Code Node)
 Combines raw registration data with AI eligibility results into one unified JSON package.
📬 Send Approval Email to Compliance Team (Gmail)
 Notifies compliance officers that an applicant passed eligibility and is ready for verification.
🧩 Prepare Status Update Fields (Set Node)
 Constructs the final status value (e.g., “passed”) for updating the database.
📘 Update Registration Status in Sheet (Google Sheets)
 Updates the applicant’s record using contactEmail as the key, marking the final eligibility status.

requirement.requirement_text: 系统在两类触发下执行：一是在印度标准时间（IST）下午 2 点至晚上 11 点之间每 6 分钟自动执行一次，二是通过外部请求按需手动触发。每次执行时，系统从板球赛事数据服务获取当前全部进行中的比赛，并动态识别出正在进行的目标赛事，识别条件为赛事名称包含“IPL”或“Indian Premier League”、赛制为 T20、比赛已开始且尚未结束；若 IPL 不在赛季期间，则回退选择任意一场进行中的 T20 比赛。识别后系统判断当前进行的是第几局并计算相应指标：第一局计算当前得分率、剩余球数、剩余 wickets、预估总分、比赛阶段（Powerplay / Middle / Death）与压力等级；第二局在此基础上还需计算所需得分率、还需得分、所需得分率与当前得分率的差值以及压力指数。这些结构化比赛上下文交由语言模型生成一段恰好 2 句、使用前述具体数字、采用板球解说语言、不使用百分比的分析师风格叙述。生成的叙述一方面连同时间戳、赛事名称、局次、当前 over、比分、目标分、所需得分率、当前得分率、阶段与压力等级追加写入 Google Sheets 日志，另一方面以结构化结果返回给调用方；若处理过程中任一环节失败，则通过邮件发出告警。

source_spans.text:
What This Workflow Does
⏰ Fires automatically every 6 minutes between 2PM and 11PM covering all IPL match windows
🌐 Accepts manual triggers via webhook for on-demand narrative generation at any time
🏏 Fetches all current cricket matches from CricAPI in real time on every execution
🔍 Dynamically identifies the live IPL match from the API response — no hardcoded match IDs
🧮 Detects which innings is active and computes all key match indicators automatically
🤖 Sends structured match context to GPT-4o which generates a 2-sentence human-sounding narrative
📝 Logs every narrative to Google Sheets with full match context for audit and analytics
📤 Returns a clean JSON response via webhook that any app or widget can poll in real time
⚠️ Fires an email alert if any node fails so you always know when the workflow needs attention

Trigger Layer Two triggers run this workflow. The Schedule Trigger fires every 6 minutes between 2PM and 11PM IST covering both day games starting around 3:30PM and evening games starting around 7:30PM. The Webhook Trigger provides a manual entry point so developers can fire the workflow on demand for testing or to power a real-time polling architecture where a frontend app hits the webhook URL every few minutes to get the latest narrative. Both triggers feed into the same API call so the logic is completely identical regardless of how the workflow was triggered.

Data Fetch & Match Detection A single HTTP Request node fetches all current cricket matches from CricAPI's /v1/currentMatches endpoint. The Code node then scans the response and dynamically finds the live IPL match by checking that the match name contains "IPL" or "Indian Premier League", the match type is T20, and the match has started but not ended. No match IDs are hardcoded anywhere — the workflow finds the right match on every execution. When IPL is not in season the workflow falls back to any live T20 match so development and testing are never blocked.

Indicator Computation Once the match is identified the Code node detects which innings is active based on how many score entries the API returns. For the 1st innings it computes the current run rate, overs remaining, wickets in hand, projected total, match phase (Powerplay / Middle / Death), and pressure level. For the 2nd innings it additionally computes the required run rate, runs needed, run rate gap between RRR and CRR, and a pressure index based on how difficult the chase is becoming. Both scenarios produce a structured flat object that gets assembled into a context-rich GPT-4o prompt tailored to the specific innings situation.

AI Narrative Generation The prompt is sent to GPT-4o via HTTP Request with a system prompt that instructs the model to write exactly 2 sentences, use the specific numbers provided, sound like a human cricket analyst, use cricket language fans understand, and never use percentages. The result is a narrative like "Mumbai Indians need 45 off 24 balls with 7 wickets in hand — the muscle is there but one collapse changes everything. Jasprit Bumrah has to be kept for the final two overs or this chase gets away from Kolkata." The narrative is then parsed from the API response and passed to both output nodes.

Output & Logging Every narrative is appended to a Google Sheets log with the full match context — timestamp, match name, innings, current over, score, target, RRR, CRR, phase, pressure level, and the narrative text. This creates a complete over-by-over record of every narrative generated across the entire match. Simultaneously the Respond to Webhook node returns a clean JSON payload containing the match name, innings, score, over, phase, pressure, narrative, and timestamp — ready for any frontend app or dashboard to consume directly.

source_spans.text:
Quick Overview
This workflow ingests meeting audio or transcripts via a webhook or a 30-minute schedule, uses OpenAI (Whisper and GPT-4.1-mini) to extract summaries, decisions, and action items, creates tasks in Asana, logs each meeting to Google Sheets, and emails a recap through SendGrid.

How it works
Receives meeting data from a webhook request or runs every 30 minutes on a schedule.
Normalizes meeting metadata (title, date, participants, audio URL, and transcript) and validates that either an audio URL or a sufficiently long transcript is present.
If only audio is provided, sends the audio URL to OpenAI Whisper to generate a transcript and merges it back into the meeting context.
Sends the transcript and metadata to OpenAI GPT-4.1-mini to extract a structured JSON summary, key topics, decisions, risks, and action items with owners and due dates.
Parses the AI JSON safely, adds counts and timestamps, and waits at a review buffer before continuing.
Splits action items into individual records and creates corresponding tasks in Asana for each one.
Appends a meeting log row to Google Sheets and sends a summary email via SendGrid, then returns a JSON status response to the webhook caller.

source_spans.text: Manually monitoring Reddit for relevant discussions can be overwhelming. This automation does all the heavy lifting by automatically searching for keywords across selected subreddits or the entire Reddit, analyzing each post with GPT-5-Mini, and saving structured insights in your Notion database. Optionally, receive daily email notifications summarizing new discussions without lifting a finger.

Daily Automated Reddit Monitoring**  
  Checks Reddit once a day for new posts matching your keywords in selected subreddits or across all of Reddit.

AI-Powered Analysis with Custom Prompts**  
  Uses GPT-5-Mini to:  
  Assign a relevance score to each post based on your defined priorities.  
  Generate a suggested comment tailored to your audience or engagement strategy.  
  Allow custom prompts so you can tweak AI behavior for lead generation, competitor monitoring, or brand mentions.

Notion Integration**  
  Saves all posts, relevance scores, and AI-generated comments directly into your Notion database for easy tracking and collaboration.

Optional Email Alerts**  
  Sends a clean, HTML-formatted email summarizing new discussions and insights.

Daily Trigger: Starts the workflow once per day.  
Reddit Search: Queries new posts based on user-defined keywords.  
AI Analysis: GPT-5-Mini evaluates relevance score and generates suggested comments based on your custom prompts.  
Save & Notify: Posts are saved to Notion and optionally summarized via email.

requirement.requirement_text: 订阅者通过表单提交姓名、邮箱、最近一次经期开始日期与平均周期天数。系统据此计算全部关键周期日期：下次经期开始日；排卵日为下次经期开始日减 14 天；易孕窗口自排卵日前 5 天开启、排卵日后 1 天结束；经前综合征（PMS）窗口自下次经期开始日前 5 天开启。日期保存后系统立即向订阅者发送一封包含完整周期概览的欢迎邮件。此后系统每天早上 8 点检查全部活跃订阅者，判断每位订阅者当天所处的阶段，并在命中以下四类触发日之一时发送对应的阶段提醒邮件：经期开始前 3 天发送准备提示；经期开始当天发送舒适与自我照护提示；排卵日发送生育意识与精力提示；PMS 窗口开始日发送情绪、精力与边界提示。发送前会检查上次发送记录，确保同一周期内同一类型的邮件只发送一次；发送后更新订阅者的最近发送记录，并将每次投递按日期、阶段、周期天数与邮件类型记入发送日志；在经期开始日会重新计算周期日期以实现持续跟踪。此外，系统每周日早上 9 点为全部活跃订阅者生成本周健康摘要：先判断订阅者当前所处的阶段（经期、卵泡期、易孕期、排卵期或 PMS），再结合姓名、阶段、周期天数与距下次经期的天数，交由语言模型生成涵盖精力管理、营养、运动、心态与本周注意事项五个类别的阶段化建议以及一句每周寄语，组装为邮件发送；每次发送同样记入发送日志。

source_spans.text:
What This Workflow Does
📝 Subscribers fill in a simple form — name, email, last period date, and cycle length
🧮 Instantly calculates all key cycle dates — next period, ovulation day, fertile window start and end, and PMS window start
📧 Sends a personalized welcome email with their complete cycle overview
🕐 Runs every morning at 8AM checking all active subscribers
🔍 Detects which phase event is happening today for each subscriber
📬 Sends the right phase-specific reminder email on the exact right day: 
- 3 days before period — preparation tips
- Period start day — comfort and self-care tips
- Ovulation day — fertility awareness and energy tips
- PMS window start — mood, energy, and boundary tips
🔒 Duplicate send prevention ensures each email type is only sent once per cycle per subscriber
📝 Updates each subscriber's last email sent record after every send
📊 Logs every delivery to Send Log sheet with date, phase, cycle day, and email type
💜 Every Sunday generates a personalized weekly wellness digest for every subscriber using GPT-4o based on their current cycle phase — with energy, nutrition, movement, and mindset tips

Key Benefits
✅ Fully automated — set up once and runs forever
✅ Every subscriber gets emails timed to their unique cycle not a generic schedule
✅ 4 different phase-specific reminder emails with tailored content and colors
✅ GPT-4o generates unique wellness tips per phase every week — never repetitive
✅ Duplicate send prevention — no subscriber ever gets the same email twice in one cycle
✅ Auto-recalculates cycle dates on period start for continuous tracking
✅ Full send log for tracking delivery history and engagement patterns

SW1 — Subscriber Intake & Cycle Calculator Subscribers open the form and enter their name, email, last period start date, and average cycle length. The workflow immediately calculates all key dates using standard cycle science — next period is last period plus cycle length, ovulation is next period minus 14 days, fertile window opens 5 days before ovulation and closes 1 day after, and PMS window starts 5 days before the next period. All dates are saved to the Subscribers sheet and a branded welcome email is sent instantly showing the subscriber their complete cycle overview with all dates laid out clearly.

SW2 — Daily Cycle Monitor & Smart Reminders Every morning at 8AM the workflow reads all active subscribers and calculates where each one is in their cycle today. It checks if today matches any of the 4 key trigger dates — 3 days before period, period start, ovulation day, or PMS start. If there is a match it builds the appropriate phase-specific HTML email with tailored tips, colors, and messaging and sends it via Gmail. Before sending it checks the last email sent field to prevent duplicate sends within the same cycle. After every send it updates the subscriber record and logs the delivery to the Send Log sheet.

SW3 — Weekly Wellness Digest Every Sunday at 9AM the workflow reads all active subscribers and calculates each one's current cycle phase — Menstrual, Follicular, Fertile, Ovulation, or PMS. It builds a personalized prompt for each subscriber including their name, phase, cycle day, and days until next period and sends it to GPT-4o. The AI generates phase-specific tips across 5 categories — energy management, nutrition, movement, mindset, and what to expect this week — plus a weekly affirmation. The response is assembled into a branded HTML email where the header color and emoji adapt automatically to the current phase. Every send is logged to the Send Log sheet.

source_spans.text: This workflow runs daily and uses SerpAPI Google Maps results to scrape US business leads by state and keyword from Google Sheets, enriches them with contact emails from websites, generates an outreach email with OpenAI, and appends the leads to a Google Sheets tab.

Runs every day at 7:00 AM via a schedule trigger.
Reads the "States" tab from Google Sheets and keeps only rows marked Active.

Expands each active state into multiple search queries using the configured keywords and formats them as “{keyword} in {state}”.
Calls SerpAPI (Google Maps engine) for each query, logs any SerpAPI errors to an "Errors" tab in Google Sheets, and splits the returned local results into individual lead items.

Normalizes each lead (name, phone, website, address, state, keyword), filters out incomplete entries, and removes duplicates using a name+phone dedupe key.
If a lead has a website, fetches the /contact page and extracts the first valid email address from the page HTML.
Uses OpenAI to generate a concise B2B outreach email for each lead and appends the lead details, extracted contact email, and AI email to the "Leads" tab in Google Sheets.

requirement.requirement_text:
学生门户通过一个统一入口接收 POST 请求，并依据请求中的动作字段将请求路由到注册、登录、意见反馈提交、CGPA 计算或资料更新五类处理。

1）注册：提取并校验学生的姓名、邮箱、学号与密码，将记录写入学生数据表，通过 Gmail 发送确认邮件，并返回 JSON 格式的成功或失败响应。
2）登录：使用提交的邮箱与密码在学生数据表中查询该学生并校验凭据，返回 JSON 格式的成功响应或凭据无效响应。
3）意见反馈提交：规范化提交的学生字段与反馈字段，将反馈存入反馈数据表，使用语言模型生成一封个性化的感谢回复邮件，通过 Gmail 发送该回复，并返回包含邮件预览的 JSON 响应。
4）CGPA 计算：将提交的各学期绩点与学分数据交由语言模型计算 CGPA，解析并校验返回结果，返回 CGPA、总学分以及所计入的学期。
5）资料更新：校验必填的资料字段，按学号确认该学生在学生数据表中存在，更新学生资料表，并返回更新后的数据或错误信息。

source_spans.text: This workflow exposes a single webhook for a student portal and routes requests to Supabase-backed registration, login, feedback tracking with AI-generated reply emails via Groq and Gmail, CGPA calculation via Mistral, and student profile updates.
Receives a POST request on a webhook and reads an action value to route the request to registration, login, feedback submission, CGPA calculation, or profile update.

For registration, it extracts and validates the student’s name, email, register number, and password, inserts the record into a Supabase table, sends a Gmail confirmation email, and returns a JSON success or failure response.
For login, it looks up the student in Supabase using the submitted email and password, checks the credentials, and returns a JSON success or invalid-credentials response.

For feedback submission, it normalizes the submitted student and feedback fields, stores the feedback in a Supabase table, uses Groq (Llama) to generate a personalized thank-you email, sends the reply via Gmail, and returns a JSON response including a preview.

For CGPA calculation, it sends the submitted semester GPA/credit data to a Mistral AI agent, parses and validates the returned JSON, and responds with the computed CGPA, total credits, and semesters used.

For profile updates, it validates required profile fields, verifies the student exists in Supabase by register number, updates a Supabase “Student Details” table, and returns the updated data or an error message.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统对临床试验的电子知情同意（e-consent）进行端到端管理。

1）接收来自受试者门户的已签署知情同意提交。
2）校验提交中的全部必填字段，并为记录附加具有法律效力的加密时间戳。
3）使用语言模型依据 ICH E6 GCP 指南审核知情同意表的完整性。
4）将记录以不可篡改的形式写入 Google Sheets，并保留完整的监管链（chain of custody）。
5）向主要研究者（PI）与受试者分别发送确认邮件。
6）每日定时检查即将到期或缺失的知情同意。
7）生成每日审计汇总报告，供监管提交使用。

source_spans.text: This workflow automates end-to-end e-consent management for clinical trials. It captures, validates, timestamps, and stores consent submissions with a full regulatory-compliant audit trail, notifies investigators and participants, and runs daily compliance checks for missing or expiring consents.

Capture E-Consent - Webhook receives signed consent submission from participant portal
Validate & Timestamp - Verifies all required fields, applies cryptographic timestamp for legal validity
Claude AI Compliance Check - Reviews consent form completeness against ICH E6 GCP guidelines
Store with Audit Trail - Writes immutable record to Google Sheets with full chain of custody
Notify PI & Participant - Sends confirmation emails to principal investigator and participant
Daily Expiry Sweep - Scheduled job checks for expiring or missing consents
Generate Compliance Report - Produces daily audit summary for regulatory submission

source_spans.text: This workflow automatically processes new GitHub issues and uses AI to classify them by type and priority. It extracts key issue data, sends it to an AI model for structured analysis, and formats the output for task creation.
The workflow then creates a task in Linear and adds a comment back to the GitHub issue.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统自动捕获、评估并分派来自邮件或网页表单的入站线索。

1）入站来源：轮询邮箱获取新的入站邮件；同时接收来自任意在线表单的提交；两路来源汇入同一处理流程。
2）校验：检查入站数据是否包含必填字段（邮箱或文本）；不合规的条目转入死信队列（DLQ）以待复核。
3）信息抽取：使用语言模型从自由文本中抽取结构化字段，包括公司名称、规模、行业、角色、地区、问题描述与预算信号。
4）评分：依据已抽取的行业、规模、角色、问题清晰度与预算信号，按明确标准计算 0–100 的线索评分，并给出线索等级（Hot、Warm、Cold、Unqualified）。
5）CRM 分派：按配置在 CRM 中创建线索，默认创建 Salesforce 线索，也可适配为 HubSpot。
6）Slack 通知：向 Slack 发送一条富文本消息，概述线索评分与评分依据，并附带一个“Create intro email”按钮以便快速处理。
7）记录：所有成功线索记入 Google Sheets 用于报表；失败或无效的线索单独记入 DLQ 标签页用于审计。

source_spans.text:
A Gmail trigger polls for new inbound emails.
   A Webhook node receives submissions from any online form.
     Both sources merge into a single pipeline.

Validation:
   Incoming data is checked for required fields (email or text). Invalid entries are routed to the Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for review.

AI Extraction:
   The OpenAI node extracts structured fields like company name, size, industry, role, region, problem statement, and budget signals from free-form text.

Parsing & Scoring:
   The AI output is parsed, then a code node calculates a 0–100 lead score based on transparent criteria—industry, size, role, problem clarity, and budget mentions. It also assigns a lead tier (Hot, Warm, Cold, Unqualified).

CRM Routing:
   Depending on your configuration, the workflow creates a Salesforce lead (default) or can be easily adapted for HubSpot. Territory or CRM owner routing can be extended here.

Slack Notification:
   A rich Slack message summarizes the lead score and reasoning and includes a “Create intro email” button for quick action.

Logging:
   All successful leads are logged to Google Sheets for reporting. Any failed or invalid leads are logged separately to the DLQ tab for auditing.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统作为学生咨询助手处理学生的聊天消息。

1）接收学生聊天消息，提取会话 ID、学生姓名与消息正文。
2）按会话维护并更新对话历史与轮次计数，以在多轮消息之间保持上下文。
3）从 Google Sheets 知识库中读取问答条目，整理为可直接用于生成回复的文本。
4）将学生消息、对话历史与知识库内容交给语言模型，生成受限格式的回复，该回复可标记“未解决”或“情绪困扰”情况。
5）检查模型回复中是否存在“未解决”或“情绪困扰”标记；当学生表现出困扰，或问题在两轮之后仍未解决时，将完整上下文升级上报到 Slack 频道。
6）将每轮对话追加写入 Google Sheets 的对话日志，并将未解决的问题单独记入“FAQ Gaps”表，用于知识库补充。
7）每周一 09:00，读取 Google Sheets 中的对话日志，计算本周指标，并通过 Gmail 向管理员发送 HTML 格式的报告邮件。

source_spans.text:
Receives a student chat message via an n8n Chat trigger and extracts the session ID, student name, and message text.
Builds and updates a per-session conversation history and turn count to maintain context across messages.
Reads Q&A entries from a Google Sheets knowledge base and formats them into prompt-ready text.
Sends the student message, conversation history, and knowledge base to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) to generate a constrained reply that can flag unresolved or distressed cases.

Checks the AI reply for unresolved and distressed markers and escalates the full context to a Slack channel when the student appears distressed or the query remains unresolved after two turns.
Appends each exchange to a Google Sheets conversation log and records unresolved questions to a separate “FAQ Gaps” sheet for knowledge base updates.
Runs every Monday at 9 AM to read the conversation log from Google Sheets, calculate weekly metrics, and email an HTML report to the admin using Gmail.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统自动采集 Instagram 达人线索并沉淀为线索库。

1）设定定向参数：目标平台（Instagram）、兴趣领域（例如“beauty & hair”）与目标国家（例如“USA”）。
2）由语言模型据此自动生成优化的 Google 搜索查询，用于查找所选领域与地区内的相关 Instagram 主页。
3）从 Google 抓取搜索结果，收集符合搜索条件的大量 Instagram 主页链接。
4）抓取这些 Instagram 主页的详细资料，包括用户名、粉丝数与个人简介（联系方式通常出现在简介中）。
5）使用语言模型从主页简介中提取邮箱地址，即使邮箱被隐藏或采用非常规写法也能识别。
6）将线索存入数据库：新线索自动新增，已有线索则按用户名、粉丝数、邮箱、领域等字段更新。

source_spans.text: Set your targeting parameters using the Edit Fields node. You can specify your platform (Instagram), field of interest such as “beauty & hair,” and target country like “USA.”

Generate intelligent search queries with an AI Agent powered by GPT-4o-mini. It automatically creates optimized Google search queries to find relevant Instagram profiles in your chosen niche and location.
Extract results from Google using Apify’s Google Search Scraper, which collects hundreds of Instagram profile URLs that match your search criteria.
Fetch detailed Instagram profile data using Apify’s Instagram Scraper. This includes usernames, follower counts, and profile bios where contact information usually appears.
Use AI to extract emails from the profile biographies with the Information Extractor node powered by GPT-3.5-turbo. It identifies emails even when they are hidden or creatively formatted.
Store verified leads in a PostgreSQL database. The workflow automatically adds new leads or updates existing ones with fields like username, follower count, email, and niche.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统把 Telegram 变成撰写并发布 X 长帖的助手。

1）用户在聊天中发送一条想法，可以是文本消息，也可以是语音消息。
2）若消息中没有文本内容，则按语音处理：先取得该语音内容，再通过语音转写服务转换为文本。
3）由语言模型分析该想法、起草 X 长帖内容，并依据用户在聊天中提出的修改意见进行修订；修订时保留最近若干轮对话上下文，以便理解“改短一些”这类指代性要求。
4）将模型生成的帖子草稿发回用户的 Telegram 聊天，供其审阅与反馈，形成多轮协作编辑。
5）当用户在聊天中给出批准关键词（例如“ok”或“approved”）时，视为批准发布；此时从结果中提取出可直接发布的干净正文。
6）将定稿内容发布到用户已关联的 X 账号。
7）发布后向发布服务查询帖子状态，判断其处于已发布、处理中还是失败：状态为已发布时，向 Telegram 发送确认消息与已发布帖子的直链；状态为处理中时，短暂等待后再次查询状态，直至有结果；若上传或处理过程中出错，则向 Telegram 发送错误通知。

source_spans.text: This n8n workflow transforms your Telegram messenger into a personal assistant for creating and publishing X-Threads.
You can simply send an idea as a text or voice message, collaboratively edit the AI’s suggestion in a chat, and then publish the finished thread directly to X just by saying “Okay.”

Checks the incoming message for text. If text is empty, it proceeds to voice handling.
Get Voice File	If a voice note is detected, this node downloads the raw audio file from Telegram.
Speech to Text	This node uses the OpenAI Whisper API to convert the downloaded audio file into a text string.

It analyzes your request, applies the “System Prompt” rules, drafts the post, and handles revisions based on your feedback.
OpenAI Chat Model	Defines the large language model (LLM) used for generating and revising the post.
Window Buffer Memory	A memory buffer that stores the last turns of the conversation, allowing the AI to maintain context when you request changes (e.g., “Make it shorter”).
Check if Approved	This crucial node detects the specific JSON structure the AI outputs only when you provide an approval keyword (like “ok” or “approved”).
Post Suggestion Or Ask For Approval	Sends the AI’s post draft back to your Telegram chat for review and feedback.

Parses the incoming JSON, extracting only the clean text ready for publishing.
Create post with Blotato	Uses the Blotato API to upload the finalized content to your connected X account.
Give Blotat 5s :)	A brief pause to allow the publishing service to start processing the request.
Check post status	Checks back with Blotato to determine if the post is published, in progress, or failed.
Published?	Checks if the status is “published” to send the success message.
In Progress?	Checks if the post is still being processed. If so, it loops back to the next wait period.
Give Blotat other 5s :)	Pauses the workflow before re-checking the post status, preventing unnecessary API calls.
Final Notification
Node Name	Role in Workflow
Send a confirmation message	Sends a confirmation message and the direct link to the published X post.
Send an error message	Sends a notification if the post failed to upload or encountered an error during processing.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统每周自动汇总指定 Google Docs 的更新情况，并通过邮件发送给团队。

1）每周一 09:00 触发执行。
2）确定受监控的 Google Docs 清单，包含文档 ID、名称与分类（例如项目、会议、更新），并设定 7 天的更新统计区间。
3）获取这些文档的内容与元数据（最后修改时间、修改人、版本），仅保留过去一周内更新过的文档。
4）提取文档的纯文本内容，进行清洗与规范化，并收集字数、修改人、最后更新日期等关键信息。
5）将所有更新过的文档汇总为一份合并内容，作为生成周报的素材。
6）使用语言模型生成商务风格的周报摘要，内容包含：执行摘要、按文档划分的关键更新、重要变更、行动事项以及下周重点。
7）将生成结果整理为纯文本与 HTML 两种格式的邮件正文，并附上更新文档清单及其最后修改信息。
8）通过 Gmail 将周报发送给已配置的团队邮箱，邮件主题中包含本次统计的日期区间。

source_spans.text:
Weekly Monday 9AM Trigger  
   A Cron node runs every Monday at 9 AM (adjustable).  
   Ensures summaries arrive at the start of the workweek.  

Prepare Docs List  
   A Code node defines which Google Docs to monitor.  
   Includes doc IDs, names, and categories (e.g., Projects, Meetings, Updates).  
   Sets a 7-day date range for updates.

Fetch Google Docs & Metadata  
   Retrieves document content and metadata (last modified, user, version).  
   Filters only docs that have been updated in the past week.  

Process Doc Data  
   Extracts plain text content from Google Docs.  
   Cleans and normalizes text for summarization.  
   Collects key details: word count, modified by, last updated date.  

Aggregate Updated Docs  
   Gathers all updated docs into one combined content block.  
   Prepares context for the AI model to create a weekly digest.

Generate AI Summary  
   Uses GPT-4 to generate a business-style weekly summary.  
   Includes:  
     Executive summary  
     Key updates by document  
     Important changes  
     Action items  
     Next week’s focus  

Prepare Email Content  
   Formats the AI response into both plain text and HTML email.  
   Adds a list of updated documents with last modified info.  

Send Summary Email  
   Sends the final summary to the configured team emails via Gmail.  
   Subject line includes the date range for easy reference.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统根据保存在 Google Drive 中的 JSON 工作流文件，自动生成可用于模板发布的说明文案并交付给指定人员。

1）由人工手动触发后开始处理。
2）在指定的 Google Drive 文件夹中搜索 JSON 格式的工作流文件。
3）逐个处理该文件夹中找到的每个 JSON 文件：下载文件并准备用于数据提取。
4）从下载的 JSON 内容中解析出工作流数据。
5）使用语言模型生成简洁的标题与详细的描述。
6）将生成结果转换为结构化的 Markdown，用于模板发布。
7）再生成同一份描述的 HTML 版本，用于邮件发送。
8）将生成的信息记入 Google Sheets 以备存档。
9）向指定收件人发送邮件，正文包含 Markdown 与 HTML 两种格式的描述内容。

source_spans.text:
Manually triggers the workflow to start processing.
Searches a specified Google Drive folder for JSON workflow files.
Iterates through each JSON file found in that folder.
Downloads each file and prepares it for data extraction.
Parses workflow data from the downloaded JSON content.
Uses Azure OpenAI GPT-4 to generate concise titles and detailed descriptions.
Converts the AI output into structured Markdown for n8n template publishing.
Creates an HTML version of the description for email delivery.
Logs generated details into a Google Sheet for record-keeping.
Sends an email containing the Markdown and HTML descriptions to the target recipient.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统在指定话题标签下自动为 Instagram 上的新帖点赞，并保持低频与去重。

1）每 2 小时在指定分钟触发一次。
2）按时间段从已配置的 Instagram 账号中轮换选择一个账号。
3）由语言模型生成一个贴合 AI/BPA 领域的真实话题标签。
4）按该话题标签抓取最近的帖子，抓取数量不超过配置的上限。
5）从抓取结果中随机选择一条帖子，并通过查重确认该帖子此前未被点赞过。
6）生成待点赞清单并上传至在线存储，随后启动自动点赞操作，对该帖子完成点赞。
7）将已点赞帖子的链接追加到已点赞记录中，以避免重复点赞。
8）通过等待进行节流，将每个账号每天的点赞次数控制在约 12 次以内。

source_spans.text:
Schedule Trigger runs every 2 hours at a specified minute.  
Select Cookie chooses a rotating Instagram session-cookie
   (time-slice logic).  
Generate Random Hashtag (GPT-4o) outputs a realistic AI/BPA
   hashtag.  
Instagram Hashtag Agent (Phantombuster) scrapes up to
   ENV_MAX_POSTS_PER_HASHTAG recent posts.  
Get Random Post selects one; duplicate checker ensures it
   hasn’t been liked before (SharePoint CSV).  
Builds instagram_posts_to_like.csv, uploads to SharePoint, then
   launches the Auto-like Agent which likes the post.  
Post URL is appended to instagram_posts_already_liked.csv to avoid
   duplicates.  
Wait nodes throttle launches to ~12 likes per profile daily.

requirement.requirement_text:
系统提供语音优先的模拟面试辅导服务。

1）接收一次 POST 请求，内容包含会话 ID、岗位角色、轮次编号以及候选人的一段录音。
2）将录音送入语音转写服务，生成文字稿。
3）分析文字稿并计算表达指标，包括填充词使用、每分钟字数、语速评估、回答过短的标记，以及本场面试是否已到最后一轮。
4）使用带会话记忆的语言模型（按会话 ID 维护上下文）生成结构化的辅导反馈、鼓励语、评分，以及下一个面试问题；若已到最后一轮，则改为生成总结收尾。
5）将辅导反馈与下一个问题通过语音合成转换为音频。
6）等待投递确认回调；确认后，向原请求返回文字稿、辅导输出、评分、下一个问题与生成的音频；若未收到确认，则返回重试提示。

source_spans.text:
Receives a POST webhook request containing a sessionId, role, turnNumber, and an audio recording from the candidate.
Sends the audio to OpenAI Speech-to-Text (Whisper) to generate a transcript.
Analyzes the transcript to compute delivery metrics such as filler-word usage, words per minute, pace assessment, short-answer flags, and whether the session reached the final turn.
Uses an OpenAI chat agent with Window Buffer Memory keyed by sessionId to produce structured JSON coaching feedback, encouragement, a score, and the next interview question (or a wrap-up on the final turn).
Converts the agent’s feedback and next question into audio using OpenAI Text-to-Speech.
Waits for a delivery-confirmation callback and then responds to the original webhook with the transcript, coaching outputs, score, next question, and generated audio (or returns a retry message if not confirmed).

requirement.requirement_text:
系统对用户提交的创业点子自动生成验证报告并邮件交付。

1）通过在线表单接收创业点子、所属行业与目标受众。
2）将提交内容交由语言模型生成专业分析，涵盖问题、商业模式与 SWOT 要素。
3）生成创业可行性评分（当前取 80–100 之间的随机值），并与上述分析一并打包。
